metadata.postgresql: PostgreSQL 17.12 (Debian 17.12-0+deb13u1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
metadata.cache_method: Warm cache; 3 untimed fetches per block per query; ABBA; shuffled query order within each repeat.
metadata.timing: Client execute and fetchall on same TCP connection, including protocol and conversion; EXPLAIN is separate.

cases.venue_year_join:
SELECT p.paper_id, p.title, au.author_id FROM paper p JOIN authorship au USING (paper_id)
        WHERE p.venue_id='V35' AND p.publication_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2022
        ORDER BY p.publication_year, p.paper_id, au.author_id LIMIT 100
cases.citation_ranking:
SELECT paper_id,title,cited_by_count FROM paper WHERE publication_year>=2020
        ORDER BY cited_by_count DESC,paper_id LIMIT 50
cases.recursive_citations:
SELECT level,citing_id,cited_id FROM citation_chain('P47981',3)
        ORDER BY level,citing_id,cited_id
cases.fuzzy_author:
SELECT author_id,name FROM author WHERE name % 'Samara Quasra'
        ORDER BY similarity(name,'Samara Quasra') DESC, author_id LIMIT 10
cases.topic_trend_base:
SELECT pt.topic_id,t.name,p.publication_year,count(DISTINCT p.paper_id)
        FROM paper p JOIN paper_topic pt USING(paper_id) JOIN topic t USING(topic_id)
        GROUP BY pt.topic_id,t.name,p.publication_year ORDER BY pt.topic_id,p.publication_year
cases.topic_trend_view:
SELECT topic_id,topic_name,publication_year,paper_count FROM topic_year_trends
        ORDER BY topic_id,publication_year
cases.author_papers:
SELECT p.paper_id,p.title FROM authorship a JOIN paper p USING(paper_id)
        WHERE a.author_id='A9001' ORDER BY p.paper_id
cases.doi_lookup: SELECT paper_id,title FROM paper WHERE doi='10.0000/study.27983'
cases.incoming_citations:
SELECT c.citing_id,p.title FROM citation c JOIN paper p ON p.paper_id=c.citing_id
        WHERE c.cited_id='P8' ORDER BY c.citing_id LIMIT 60
cases.title_contains:
SELECT paper_id,title FROM paper WHERE title ILIKE '%quasar%'
        ORDER BY paper_id LIMIT 50
